answer: A challenger who proves a claim false seizes half the bond; a false challenger forfeits its own. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers periodically challenge random claims. Like a karst spring feeding a river, trust flows only from verified stake, and reputation grows slowly along a vine of attestations, so forging many identities costs more than it ever returns. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
